newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dai-ichi Life to buy over Y300 bln foreign bonds.
newsitem.headline: Dai-ichi Life to buy over Y300 bln foreign bonds.

text.p: Dai-ichi Mutual Life Insurance Co plans more than 300 billion yen worth of fresh investment in foreign bonds in fiscal 1997/98, which started on April 1, a company official said on Monday.
The official also said the company plans 500 billion yen of new investment in domestic bonds in the same period.
The official also said that the company plans to raise its foundation funds, which are equivalent to capital, by 150 billion yen in the current financial year.
